items.proposed: drop row (no selection biomarker for NF1/RAS)
items.reason: "Known or suspected neurofibromatosis-1 (NF-1) and/or RAS related gene alterations" is an exclusion criterion, not an entry requirement, so it should not be an eligibility row; the trial's candidate-matched selection is carried by the BRAF V600E / BRAF fusion requirements matched to plixorafenib, so the primary outcome is true either way.

Subprotocol B cites "WHO [2021] Grade 3 or 4 primary CNS tumor"; historical terms ("Grade 1-4 glioma", "anaplastic astrocytoma") also appear, and when both cns5 and historical criteria are met C8 says code cns5.

note: BRAF role (eligibility vs enrichment) differs between coders (priority 3); every subprotocol requires a BRAF alteration, so either way candidate_matched_selection = true. WHO 2021 citation is in the paediatric clause of Subprotocol B.
